Usage: ocfl commit <path> [flags]

Create or update an object using contents of a local directory

Arguments:
  <path>    local directory with object state to commit

Flags:
  -h, --help              Show context-sensitive help.
      --root=STRING       The prefix/directory of the OCFL storage root used for
                          the command ($OCFL_ROOT)
      --debug             enable debug log messages

  -i, --id=STRING         The ID for the object to create or update
  -m, --message=STRING    Message to include in the object version metadata
  -n, --name=STRING       Username to include in the object version metadata
                          ($OCFL_USER_NAME)
  -e, --email=STRING      User email to include in the object version metadata
                          ($OCFL_USER_EMAIL)
      --alg="sha512"      Digest algorithm (ignored for commits to existing
                          objects)
      --no-hidden         exclude hidden files and directories (.*)
